appointment.message: Appointments are available during clinic hours.

emergency.message: Emergency dental assistance is available during opening hours.

aiRules: Answer using only the business information provided.
Do not invent prices, services, discounts, policies, timings, or medical information.
If requested information is unavailable, say: I don't have that information. A staff member can help you.
When a customer wants to book an appointment, collect their name and phone number.
